description: This file defines the Smarty_Data class, which is a data object used within the Smarty templating system to hold template variables in the current scope. It manages data like counters, data block names, and references to the Smarty object, and includes logic for initialization with parent data.

classes.name: Smarty_Data
classes.description: Represents a data object for Smarty templates, holding variables, counters, and references to the Smarty instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Smarty_Data object, setting up dynamic data based on the provided parent data or Smarty instance, incrementing count, and setting a name.
